text_markup: One card, {card:Mutate}, has an ability that installs a piece of ice in the "same position" as a particular piece of ice that was previously trashed. This is a different usage of "same position" from that described in {ref:rule_count_positions}. For this installation, the ice is installed protecting the same server the trashed ice was protecting, and the new position is created at the same place in that server's sequence of positions as the position the trashed ice had.
text_plain: One card, Mutate, has an ability that installs a piece of ice in the "same position" as a particular piece of ice that was previously trashed. This is a different usage of "same position" from that described in rule 6.2.3. For this installation, the ice is installed protecting the same server the trashed ice was protecting, and the new position is created at the same place in that server's sequence of positions as the position the trashed ice had.
